impact: zug version and zug --version print "1.0.0" unconditionally. After any npm version bump the CLI will report stale version information, making it impossible to verify which version is installed via the CLI itself.
resolution: Replaced hardcoded "1.0.0" string with a runtime read from package.json using fs.readFileSync + __dirname. The compiled CLI (dist/cli.js) reads ../package.json at startup, so version output will always match the installed package version without any code changes needed after version bumps.
title: [bug] CLI version hardcoded as "1.0.0" — lies after any version bump
